note: Hand-authored, not generated — this describes Claude Code tooling around the repo, not the repo's own source. Split deliberately into 'built for this project' vs 'generic tooling that happens to be connected' — conflating them would misrepresent what's actually multi-app's own.

personalAgentTeamRouting.statement: A project-agnostic personal subagent team (sprinter, analyst, planner/planner-opus, implementer, main session) is available and routed by task shape — not defined in this repo.

mechanism.note: global, user-level instructions; this repo's own .claude/ only has settings.local.json, no agents/skills directory of its own

roles.usedWhen: target file(s), exact change, and a named validation step are ALL already stated
clear, repeatable, read-heavy, high-volume extraction/classification/comparison/review; no edits
well-specified, moderate-scope implementation; approach and acceptance criteria already decided
ambiguous, high-impact, architectural, security-sensitive, or repeatedly-failing work
integrated implementation, multi-file work, tool-heavy execution, coordination, verification — the default

planCommands.context: forked, isolated — no conversation history, states assumptions instead of asking
same as /plan-solo, model pinned to Opus

planCommands.runs: interactive planning inline in the current session
planCommands.context: used for THIS task — genuine open forks (doc-consolidation scope, memory boundary, audit depth) needed live AskUserQuestion answers, which a forked subagent cannot do

mcpServersBuiltForThisProject.name: multi-memory
mcpServersBuiltForThisProject.statement: Exposes the multi-graph-memory engine's read surface as MCP tools: fgm_project_status, fgm_list_episodes, fgm_list_lessons, fgm_query_events, fgm_read_memory_context, fgm_get_lesson.

mechanism.note: B1 (stdio, ReadOnlyMcpServer) + B2 (Streamable HTTP) — see memory-system-ladder.json
mechanism.staleness: not-applicable — not a single trackable file (a glob or a directory)

mcpServersBuiltForThisProject.knownDefect: Scoped to workspace "multi-app" / project "builder", resolving to the shared builder.db — the SAME store multi-app's own memory/bridge.js writes to (since commit 6360b37, corrected 2026-09-06; the .multi-app/.multi-memory/build-*.db files are pre-migration legacy data, not a live parallel store). fgm_project_status returned 0 events/0 episodes/0 lessons because that store is genuinely still empty of real activity, not because the MCP surface is pointed at the wrong file. See gaps-bugs-and-need-to-handle.json#mcp-server-scoped-to-empty-store for the fix applied.

skillsUsedOnThisTask.usedFor: visual-design guidance for architecture/index.html, applied against DESIGN.md's already-locked token system rather than inventing a new palette

genericToolingConnectedButNotProjectSpec.note: Found by checking which MCP server names also appear in ~/.cache/claude-cli-nodejs/ for dozens of unrelated project directories on this machine — a project-specific tool would not do that.
